note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), quoted verbatim from the bundled owb-am text (backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. It replaces the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS) wording and the self-rendered OT wording this edition first shipped with.

2026-11-18 re-quote: a partial quotation is the shortest contiguous OWB span that carries Edwards' clause; a range is the OWB verses joined by a space; nested speech inside a verse is written ‹…›. Where Edwards argues from a KJV word OWB no longer has, the translated prose carries a minimal bridging gloss (notably the Hebrew 'repent' gloss after Genesis 6:6 / Numbers 23:19 / 1 Samuel 15:29, and Isaiah 42:4's 'not fail nor be discouraged').

self_rendered rows are: Acts 15:18 (OWB's critical text lacks 'known unto God are all his works', the words Edwards argues from, so they are rendered from the English); four Daniel fragments that Edwards strings into a list of '-ing' phrases, given in OWB's vocabulary in noun form; and allusions or bare citations in Edwards' own voice that quote no wording.

block_index is the global block index across all 32 sections (the

||| split). The earlier notes filed 14 references on blocks 242/248 and one (Matthew 7:12) that the work never cites; those are re-filed at their true blocks or dropped.

Edwards argues with close philosophical terms (moral and natural necessity, inability, contingence, self-determination); each is fixed once in the shared glossary and used the same way in all 32 sections.
